title: Desktop-update follow-ups from the 11/10 dev acceptance: the docs host's Scalar page lets the edge analytics beacon load; the API host answers /.well-known/* with a plain 404 instead of a 302 to /login; the docs sidebar lists the API changelog once (Changelog › API); a desktop product window that cannot load its page shows a local "can't connect" page with Retry instead of a blank chrome-error page
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
S3: Run `node --test packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/shell-strings.test.mjs` and read its summary.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok: the reference page's CSP names static.cloudflareinsights.com in script-src and cloudflareinsights.com in connect-src and nothing wider; GET/HEAD/POST /.well-known/<x> on the API host is 404 with no Location and `private, no-store`, even with a catch-all that redirects mounted after the gate; the sidebar names /changelog/ once, under Changelog › API; a main-frame did-fail-load (not ERR_ABORTED, http(s) URL) shows the unreachable page with Retry to the failed Tracy address (or the window's home when the failed address is off Tracy), a sub-frame failure or a local page failure shows nothing.
Every one of the eight shell languages carries the four unreachable.* words with the English placeholders.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/api-reference/route.js cspFor; apps/tracy-web/src/app.js API host block (/.well-known/*); apps/tracy-docs/sidebar.mjs TREE; packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/src/load-failure.js retryTarget, unreachableQuery, watchLoadFailure; src/main.js createWindow

fence: The Scalar page's CSP takes the two beacon hosts from lib/security-headers.js (EDGE_BEACON_SCRIPT, EDGE_BEACON_REPORT), the same constants the rendered pages use; the API host's /.well-known/* handler is registered right after the host gate, before every domain router; the desktop window is replaced only for a main-frame failure of an http(s) page that is not ERR_ABORTED. No network, no database, no build, no Electron window.

tests: the page may call the API host and nothing else: connect-src names it, scripts stay self
the edge analytics beacon Cloudflare injects may load and report — exactly its two hosts (DT-2)
API host: an unpublished /.well-known/* file is a plain 404, never a redirect to sign-in (DT-3)
the sidebar reads Get started · Using Tracy · Desktop app · Changelog · For developers
every page appears once in the sidebar: the API changelog only under Changelog › API (DT-4)
the main frame failing to load a Tracy page shows the page, Retry going back to that page
a sub-frame failing never replaces the window (a site preview, an embedded page)
ERR_ABORTED is a navigation someone stopped, not a failure: nothing is shown
a local page of the shell failing (file:, data:, about:) is left alone, so the page cannot loop
Retry stays on Tracy: a main-frame failure elsewhere retries the window’s home page
the page is handed the Retry address, the error code and its words in the system language
an OS language outside the eight: English
the page draws exactly the unreachable.* words the table holds
